data.name: Nithar
data.gender_notes: Nithar is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Islamic tradition, Nithar is derived from the Arabic word 'nathirah' which means 'shining light' or 'radiant'. It's mentioned in the Quran, where it refers to the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) and his mission to guide people to the right path. The name symbolizes guidance, enlightenment, and spiritual growth. The name Nithar carries the meaning “Light, Radiant” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Nithar usually hope their child will grow to embody light, radiant and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for those who guide others towards the right path in life.
data.etymology: Nithar belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Light, Radiant.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nithar total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
